name: Solo violin: Paganini's Caprice No. 19
description: Here's Paganini's Caprice No. 19 on a single violin. Our string players can also play Bach at your wedding ceremony, or Coldplay arranged for strings.
more: You can book one violinist, a duo, a trio or a full quartet. A duo is a violin and a cello, and it's the size most often booked for a ceremony and cocktail hour together. A third player adds harmony, so pop songs and film themes sound fuller.
